name: SH-2: every section timed out → untested, never clean

expected.explanation: No sections have been evaluated yet.

why: W03: a run in which every section timed out (NXDOMAIN/REFUSED/SERVFAIL-style non-response, modeled as untested) is unmeasured evidence. It must read untested — an honest 'we measured nothing' — and must never produce an affirmative clean or count toward the MajorCount >= 2 conclusive-clean requirement.
